levels.name: Verana Certified Associate
levels.subtitle: Fundamentals
levels.how: Self-study of the open material and an online knowledge exam on veranafoundation.org. No certificator involved. Free until the end of 2027.

levels.name: Verana Certified Professional
levels.subtitle: In a role track
levels.how: The modules of a track: a proctored knowledge exam administered by the Foundation and a practical lab or case study graded by an Authorized Certificator. Workshops are optional.

levels.name: Verana Certified Expert
levels.subtitle: In a role track
levels.how: Level 2 held for a year, a portfolio of real deployments or engagements, and an oral defense before two Certified Instructors from two certificators. Opens with a later program version.

modules.title: Verifiable Trust fundamentals
modules.summary: The problem Verifiable Trust solves, Verifiable Services and User Agents, the Essential Credential Schemas, the three questions and trust resolution.

modules.title: The Verana Public Registry
modules.summary: Corporations, Ecosystems, credential schemas, the participant tree, onboarding processes, sessions, fees and trust deposits.

modules.title: Ecosystem governance
modules.summary: Governance frameworks, roles, fees, revocation and slashing, and the economics of an ecosystem.

modules.title: Playground practicum
modules.summary: Run the demos with a wallet, read a Proof-of-Trust, resolve a DID on the indexer, read a participant tree.

modules.title: VS Agent operations
modules.summary: Deploy VS Agent with Docker Compose and Helm, did:webvh, ECS onboarding, the Admin API, upgrades and backups.

modules.title: Building verifiable services
modules.summary: Issuance and verification on DIDComm and OpenID4VC, schemas and VTJSC, AnonCreds and SD-JWT, the MCP server.

modules.title: Wallet and user-agent integration
modules.summary: The trust screen, gating accept and share, the Proof-of-Trust kit and the conformance harness.

modules.title: Ecosystem operations on chain
modules.summary: Frontend and CLI, creating Ecosystems and schemas, participant management, keys and accounts, indexer and resolver APIs, TRQP.

modules.title: Network infrastructure
modules.summary: Indexer, resolver, faucet, monitoring, and the boundary with what the Council governs.

modules.title: Security
modules.summary: Key management, did:webvh log integrity, incident response, post-quantum roadmap.

modules.title: Solution design
modules.summary: Mapping a use case to Ecosystems and schemas, with the Vesta, Verandia, CEXA and BHI patterns.

modules.title: Demonstration and pre-sales
modules.summary: Delivering the playground story, handling objections, competitive positioning.

modules.title: Procurement and tenders
modules.summary: Writing and evaluating requirements, compliance matrices, public-sector alignment.

modules.title: Legal and compliance
modules.summary: eIDAS 2, GDPR and data minimization, liability in governance frameworks, licensing, token considerations.

modules.title: Economics
modules.summary: The VNA token, trust deposits, fee models, pricing an ecosystem.

modules.title: Running an ecosystem
modules.summary: Authoring a governance framework, onboarding operations, disputes, audits.

modules.title: Instructor module
modules.summary: Delivering the official material, proctoring, grading rubrics.

tracks.name: Fundamentals
tracks.audience: Anyone who needs to understand how Verifiable Trust works: product managers, analysts, partners, students.
tracks.summary: The core modules and one online exam. The entry point of the program and the prerequisite of every Level 2 track.

tracks.name: Developer and Integrator
tracks.audience: Engineers building on VS Agent or integrating a wallet.
tracks.summary: Build and operate a verifiable service, or integrate a user agent, and prove it on the test network.

tracks.name: Infrastructure Engineer
tracks.summary: Deploy, monitor and secure VS Agent and the network services around it.

tracks.name: Solutions Consultant
tracks.summary: Map a use case to Ecosystems, schemas, roles and fees, and defend the design.

tracks.name: Pre-sales
tracks.summary: Deliver the playground story live, answer objections, position Verana against alternatives.

tracks.name: Ecosystem Operator
tracks.audience: Staff of a governing body or registry operator.
tracks.summary: Create and run an Ecosystem on chain: governance framework, schemas, participants, fees, disputes.

tracks.name: Legal and Compliance
tracks.audience: Counsel, data protection and compliance officers.
tracks.summary: Governance frameworks as contracts, eIDAS 2 and GDPR alignment, liability and licensing.

tracks.name: Procurement and Tenders
tracks.summary: Write and evaluate requirements for Verifiable Trust deployments, build compliance matrices.

tracks.name: Wallet Provider
tracks.summary: Make a wallet a Verifiable User Agent and pass the conformance harness.

tracks.name: AI Agent Builder
tracks.summary: Give an AI agent its own verifiable identity and let it trust and be trusted.

trackRules.modules: Modules required in full, with their assessment.
trackRules.choice: Groups of modules of which one must be completed.
trackRules.reduced: Modules whose material is required reading and whose exam questions enter the track exam, without the module's practical assessment.

designations.name: Verana Certified Integrator
designations.for: Organizations that build products and services on Verana.
evidence: A verifiable service operated by the organization, live on a Verana network and passing the conformance checks designated by the curriculum.

designations.name: Verana Certified Solution Provider
designations.for: Organizations that sell, resell or advise on Verana-based solutions.
evidence: Two customer references, or one documented engagement reviewed by the certificator.

designations.name: Verana Certified Operator
designations.for: Organizations that run their own Ecosystem or verifiable services on Verana.
evidence: A live Ecosystem or verifiable service operated by the organization.
